model_selection.summary: Native for new root turns and subagents; an active root model cannot be changed retroactively.

current_session.detail: Subagent models can be selected, but the active root turn keeps its model.

launcher.detail: The launcher, CLI, or App Server can select the model for a new turn.

reasoning_effort.summary: Native for supported models at new-turn or subagent launch; accepted values are surface/model dependent.

current_session.detail: Subagent effort can be selected, while root-turn effort remains fixed.

launcher.detail: A new turn can receive model_reasoning_effort or an App Server effort value.

parallel_agents.summary: Native subagent workflows with a configurable concurrent-thread cap.

current_session.detail: The active session can spawn a bounded number of parallel subagents.

launcher.detail: Session configuration can cap open spawned-agent threads.

agent_roles.summary: Custom agents can carry distinct instructions, model, effort, sandbox, MCP, and skills.

current_session.detail: Configured project roles can be selected for spawned agents.

launcher.detail: A launcher can provide role-specific agent configuration files.

context_budget.summary: Compaction and instruction-size controls exist, but no stable per-task repository-context hard cap exists.

current_session.detail: PowerKit can scope reads and summaries but cannot hard-cap the provider context.

launcher.detail: A launcher can tune compaction/context settings while PowerKit scopes repository reads.

tool_restriction.summary: MCP/apps and several built-ins are configurable; hooks do not cover every hosted tool.

current_session.detail: Trusted hooks and configured tool policies cover many local calls, not every transport.

launcher.detail: Launch configuration can restrict coarse tools, MCP, and apps, but not through one universal allowlist.

filesystem_scope.summary: Local sandboxes and beta permission profiles can enforce read/write/deny path scopes.

current_session.detail: An active turn cannot tighten its root sandbox; subagents can use stricter role sandboxes.

launcher.detail: A launcher can select read-only, workspace-write, or a fine-grained permission profile.

network_restriction.summary: Command-network controls do not automatically cover web search, apps, MCP, browser, or model traffic.

current_session.detail: PowerKit must account for each network transport; the active root boundary cannot be tightened globally.

launcher.detail: Command networking and several other transports can be disabled separately, but no single global switch covers all.

shell_restriction.summary: The shell tool and login-shell behavior are configurable; command rules can add prefix-level policy.

current_session.detail: A trusted hook can block many shell calls, but active tool availability is already established.

launcher.detail: Launch configuration can disable the shell tool or restrict it with policy.

max_iterations.summary: No stable Codex-client maximum-turn setting is documented.

current_session.detail: PowerKit can count phases but cannot hard-stop the active client after N turns.

launcher.detail: An outer harness can interrupt or time-bound execution.

checkpoints.summary: Approval policies and tool gates are native; semantic phase checkpoints need workflow or hook translation.

current_session.detail: Human checkpoints work, but they are native only when tied to a concrete gated command or tool.

launcher.detail: Launch approval policy can gate actions; architecture milestones still require outer workflow coordination.

execution_isolation.summary: OS sandboxes and app worktrees exist, but worktrees are not security sandboxes.

current_session.detail: A running root turn cannot be moved retroactively into a fresh worktree or sandbox.

launcher.detail: The app can launch a managed worktree and sandbox, without isolating secrets, processes, or all network paths.

runtime_browser.summary: Shell tests are broadly available; built-in browser and Computer Use are app-specific and permissioned.

current_session.detail: The desktop app can use an installed/authorized browser capability; otherwise only shell tests are native.

launcher.detail: Browser availability depends on the app surface, plugin, and site permissions.

usage_telemetry.summary: JSON/App Server token usage and opt-in OpenTelemetry expose observed metrics on supported paths.

current_session.detail: Capture observed usage only when the current host emits it.

launcher.detail: A launcher can capture JSON/App Server/OTel events; cost remains estimated.

external_write_gating.summary: Apps and MCP tools expose write/destructive approvals, but local and external writes have separate control planes.

current_session.detail: Configured app/MCP approval modes can gate known writes; PowerKit still needs a human authorization invariant.

launcher.detail: Per-app/per-tool approval settings cover declared tools, not arbitrary external side effects.

mcp_restriction.summary: MCP servers and enabled/disabled tools can be controlled explicitly.

current_session.detail: The active session uses its already-loaded MCP policy; PowerKit can choose not to invoke exposed tools.

launcher.detail: Launch configuration can enable/disable MCP servers and tools.

translations.note: Vendor model names are adapter data and require active-surface availability.
May be overridden by an explicit spawn model.
NARROW_SCOPED_WRITE requires a separately defined permission profile.
An empty launch override disables configured MCP servers for this broker-owned invocation.

app.label: desktop app
app.validation_detail: The active desktop environment and bundled client version 0.147.0-alpha.6.5 were identified on 2026-08-17; no app-surface control invocation was exercised.

cli.label: local CLI / IDE
cli.validation_detail: A broker-owned stdin/ephemeral invocation on bundled client 0.147.0-alpha.6.5 passed gpt-5.6-terra, low reasoning, one-agent cap, read-only sandbox, disabled shell tool, and empty MCP configuration, then returned the expected response on 2026-08-17; this validates that combination, not every control row.

execution_isolation.summary: OS sandboxing is native; Git worktree creation is external to the CLI task.

current_session.detail: A running CLI root turn cannot be retroactively isolated.

launcher.detail: A launcher can create a Git worktree and select a native sandbox separately.

runtime_browser.summary: Shell-based tests are native; built-in browser and Computer Use are not CLI capabilities.

current_session.detail: Runtime commands work; browser testing requires an explicit MCP or test runner.

launcher.detail: A launcher can attach an explicit browser MCP/test runner, not the app browser.

cloud.label: Codex cloud
cloud.validation_detail: Documentation-backed only in this release; no separate hosted cloud task was launched.

model_selection.summary: Current cloud chats do not expose broker-controlled model selection.

current_session.detail: The active cloud task model is host-selected.

launcher.detail: No documented cloud-task model selector is exposed to PowerKit.

reasoning_effort.summary: The host may expose intelligence controls, but PowerKit cannot assume a portable cloud effort setting.

current_session.detail: PowerKit can request deeper behavior but cannot read back or enforce cloud effort.

launcher.detail: No portable launcher effort contract is documented for Codex cloud.

execution_isolation.summary: Cloud tasks run in isolated hosted containers.

current_session.detail: The cloud task already runs in a hosted isolated environment.

launcher.detail: Cloud task launch provides hosted environment isolation.

runtime_browser.summary: The desktop app browser capability is not a Codex cloud-task contract.

current_session.detail: Use shell tests or an explicitly configured external browser tool.

launcher.detail: No built-in cloud browser guarantee is documented.
